BackstoryDef.title: crown ward
BackstoryDef.description: Raised in a Court chapterhouse, [PAWN_nameDef] learned letters from confiscated books and sword forms from the morning bell. Every lesson ended with the same promise: service would buy a place behind the walls.

BackstoryDef.title: siege survivor
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] survived a settlement siege by hiding in a broken water cistern. The Court arrived after the killing and offered food, shelter and a new oath. [PAWN_pronoun] still struggles to distinguish rescue from recruitment.

BackstoryDef.title: oathling initiate
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] escorted tithe caravans and drilled among the Court's newest disciples. A summoned sword was proof of belonging; a full ascension remained something to earn, and something the officers used to demand obedience.

BackstoryDef.title: crown enforcer
BackstoryDef.description: As a Court Knight, [PAWN_nameDef] guarded roads, collected tribute and enforced verdicts delivered beneath the broken crown. [PAWN_pronoun] learned how quickly protection becomes occupation when no one can refuse it.

BackstoryDef.title: cinder prelate
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] once burned plague stores to keep a besieged city alive. The Court made a ceremony of that terrible choice. After mastering azure fire, [PAWN_pronoun] became the officer who turns retreat into a sudden countercharge.

BackstoryDef.title: scarlet courier
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] carried sealed executions between distant Court holds. Years of lethal pursuits refined lightning into a scarlet storm. Now [PAWN_pronoun] commands the riders who cut off escape before the main force arrives.

BackstoryDef.title: winter warden
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] guarded a mountain reservoir through a winter of siege. The Court praised the discipline that kept its soldiers alive and its subjects thirsty. Glacial ascension turned that patience into the power to halt an entire charge.

BackstoryDef.title: sky duelist
BackstoryDef.description: A champion of the Court's high-bridge dueling schools, [PAWN_nameDef] learned to win by controlling where an opponent could stand. As a Gale Herald, [PAWN_pronoun] breaks formations and delivers isolated fighters to the waiting blades below.

BackstoryDef.title: citadel marshal
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] rebuilt a breached Court fortress while fighting still raged inside it. Adamant ascension followed the refusal to yield another step. To [PAWN_objective], a squad is a moving citadel, and every retreat is a wall left unfinished.

BackstoryDef.title: oathbreaker
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] deserted after a Court recovery expedition became a punishment of civilians. [PAWN_pronoun] kept the oath's manifested uniform and [PAWN_possessive] elemental training, but abandoned the officers who claimed to own both.
